featured_items.original_text:
Chinese appliance giants are cashing in on Europe’s record heat waves, with demand for air conditioners surging just as the EU debates new tariffs on Chinese imports. According to Chinese customs data, exports of air conditioners to EU countries hit $3.76 billion in the first half of 2026, up 43.2% year on year, setting a new record. Shipments to France, the Netherlands and Belgium more than doubled in the first five months, while Spain, Germany and Portugal also saw strong double-digit growth. On retail platforms the spike was even starker: at JD dot com’s European site Joybuy, AC sales jumped nearly 40 times during the June 19-25 heatwave compared with early June. Consumers are queuing and driving across borders to find stock. One Austrian buyer drove 200km to Linz to buy the last Midea PortaSplit in the country.

The boom is led by portable and easy-install models from Gree, Haier, Hisense, Midea and TCL, which fit Europe’s housing constraints better than traditional split systems. In many historic European cities, drilling into facades is banned and professional installation can cost 1,500 to 2,000 euros with waits of two months. Midea’s PortaSplit, priced around 1,000 euros and weighing under 10kg, requires no professional fitting and sold 200,000 units in Europe this year, double 2025 levels. Midea expects European consumer AC sales to grow more than 20% in Q2, Haier could see double-digit growth in the segment, and Gree reported sales in France, Italy and Spain up over 40% in the first half. Euromonitor projects Haier, Gree and Midea will together hold about 32% of the European retail AC market by volume. Chinese officials and state media are framing the surge as proof that Europe needs Chinese products, with Xinhua calling it the air conditioner paradox: Europe is too hot for tariffs on China. That argument is landing amid broader EU-China talks over a nearly 360 billion euro trade imbalance, even as commodity costs and weak domestic demand at home pressure margins for the manufacturers.

- World Business News.
featured_items.translation_zh:
中国家电巨头正从欧洲创纪录的热浪中获利，空调需求激增，而此时欧盟正就对中国进口商品征收新关税展开讨论。根据中国海关数据，2026年上半年，对欧盟国家的空调出口额达到 37.6 亿美元，同比增长 43.2%，创下新纪录。前五个月，对法国、荷兰和比利时的发货量增长了一倍多，而西班牙、德国和葡萄牙也出现了强劲的两位数增长。在零售平台上，这一激增更为明显：在 JD.com 的欧洲网站 Joybuy 上，6月19日至25日热浪期间的空调销量较6月初跃升近 40 倍。消费者正在排队并跨境驾车寻找库存。一名奥地利买家驾车 200km 前往林茨，买下了该国最后一台 Midea PortaSplit。

这轮热潮由 Gree、Haier、Hisense、Midea 和 TCL 的便携式及易安装机型引领，这些机型比传统分体式系统更适合欧洲的住房限制。在许多欧洲历史名城，禁止在外立面钻孔，而专业安装费用可达 1,500 至 2,000 欧元，等待时间长达两个月。Midea 的 PortaSplit 售价约 1,000 欧元，重量低于 10kg，无需专业安装，今年在欧洲售出 200,000 台，是 2025 年水平的两倍。Midea 预计第二季度欧洲消费者空调销量将增长超过 20%，Haier 在该细分市场可能实现两位数增长，Gree 报告称上半年在法国、意大利和西班牙的销售额增长超过 40%。Euromonitor 预计，按销量计算，Haier、Gree 和 Midea 合计将占欧洲零售空调市场约 32%。中国官员和官方媒体正将这波激增描述为欧洲需要中国产品的证据，新华社称其为空调悖论：欧洲热到无法对中国征收关税。在欧中围绕近 3600 亿欧元贸易失衡展开更广泛谈判之际，这一论点正在产生影响，尽管大宗商品成本和国内需求疲软也在挤压制造商的利润率。

- World Business News.

她那种假的“wannabe”人设让人们不想和她做朋友。她屡屡不成功的记录意味着没人想和她合作。没人信任她，因此 Harry 也一样。他们负担不起那栋大得离谱又过时的房子的房贷，负担不起安保、助理、保姆、员工的工资。他们负担不起昂贵的加州学费。他们负担不起在 Montecito 维持那种生活方式。

effective_posts.text:
Chinese appliance giants are cashing in on Europe’s record heat waves, with demand for air conditioners surging just as the EU debates new tariffs on Chinese imports. According to Chinese customs data, exports of air conditioners to EU countries hit $3.76 billion in the first half of 2026, up 43.2% year on year, setting a new record. Shipments to France, the Netherlands and Belgium more than doubled in the first five months, while Spain, Germany and Portugal also saw strong double-digit growth. On retail platforms the spike was even starker: at JD dot com’s European site Joybuy, AC sales jumped nearly 40 times during the June 19-25 heatwave compared with early June. Consumers are queuing and driving across borders to find stock. One Austrian buyer drove 200km to Linz to buy the last Midea PortaSplit in the country.

The boom is led by portable and easy-install models from Gree, Haier, Hisense, Midea and TCL, which fit Europe’s housing constraints better than traditional split systems. In many historic European cities, drilling into facades is banned and professional installation can cost 1,500 to 2,000 euros with waits of two months. Midea’s PortaSplit, priced around 1,000 euros and weighing under 10kg, requires no professional fitting and sold 200,000 units in Europe this year, double 2025 levels. Midea expects European consumer AC sales to grow more than 20% in Q2, Haier could see double-digit growth in the segment, and Gree reported sales in France, Italy and Spain up over 40% in the first half. Euromonitor projects Haier, Gree and Midea will together hold about 32% of the European retail AC market by volume. Chinese officials and state media are framing the surge as proof that Europe needs Chinese products, with Xinhua calling it the air conditioner paradox: Europe is too hot for tariffs on China. That argument is landing amid broader EU-China talks over a nearly 360 billion euro trade imbalance, even as commodity costs and weak domestic demand at home pressure margins for the manufacturers.

- World Business News.

这轮热潮由 Gree、Haier、Hisense、Midea 和 TCL 的便携式及易安装机型引领，这些机型比传统分体式系统更适合欧洲的住房限制。在许多欧洲历史名城，禁止在外立面钻孔，而专业安装费用可达 1,500 至 2,000 欧元，等待时间长达两个月。Midea 的 PortaSplit 售价约 1,000 欧元，重量低于 10kg，无需专业安装，今年在欧洲售出 200,000 台，是 2025 年水平的两倍。Midea 预计第二季度欧洲消费者空调销量将增长超过 20%，Haier 在该细分市场可能实现两位数增长，Gree 报告称上半年在法国、意大利和西班牙的销售额增长超过 40%。Euromonitor 预计，按销量计算，Haier、Gree 和 Midea 合计将占欧洲零售空调市场约 32%。中国官员和官方媒体正将这波激增描述为欧洲需要中国产品的证据，新华社称其为空调悖论：欧洲热到无法对中国征收关税。在欧中围绕近 3600 亿欧元贸易失衡展开更广泛谈判之际，这一论点正在产生影响，尽管大宗商品成本和国内需求疲软也在挤压制造商的利润率。

“如果欧盟坚持其单边行动，中国将依法坚决反制。”

【 E-commerce : Beijing bloque les mesures d’enquête extraterritoriales de Bruxelles sur JD.com 】
🛒📱Le ministère chinois de la Justice a annoncé, le 19 août, que les mesures d’enquête transfrontalières menées par la Commission Européenne sur le groupe chinois JD.com constituaient des mesures de compétence extraterritoriale abusive, et qu’aucune organisation ni aucun individu ne devait exécuter ou aider à exécuter cette mesure. La décision a été prise en concertation avec le ministère chinois du Commerce, conformément aux articles 3 et 6 du règlement chinois contre les mesures extraterritoriales indues.
🏛️Le 28 mai dernier, la Commission européenne avait ouvert une enquête approfondie au titre du règlement sur les subventions étrangères (FSR), concernant le projet d'acquisition de l'enseigne allemande de commerce d'électronique CECONOMY par JD.com Le géant chinois est accusé d’avoir bénéficié de financements préférentiels, d'avantages fiscaux et d'aides budgétaires.
JD.com est le 3e plus grand acteur du e-commerce en Chine. Après une décennie de tentatives infructueuses pour pénétrer le marché européen, le groupe chinois y est désormais en expansion rapide, après la mise en ligne d’une nouvelle version de sa plateforme Joybuy en mars dernier. (Image : CFP)

【中国称欧盟对京东收购案的调查构成“不当域外管辖”？】

中国周三（8月19日）表示，欧盟针对中国电商巨头京东（JD.com

这项由中国司法部发布的声明，是中国第二次援引《反外国不当域外管辖条例》。该法规于今年4月出台，扩充了中国在与欧盟等打交道时可用的工具箱。此前，中国曾在5月针对欧盟对中国安检设备制造商同方威视（Nuctech）发起调查时，发布过类似命令。

中国司法部发言人同一天表示，欧盟“肆意向中国实体跨境索取广泛和非必要的中国境内信息，是对相关实体施加的不当要求，严重破坏国际法治”。他还指出，“如果欧盟一意孤行，继续采取单边行动，中方将依法采取坚决反制措施。”

欧盟委员会于今年5月依据《外国补贴条例》，对京东拟斥资25亿欧元收购德国电子产品零售商Ceconomy一事展开调查，担心京东获得了足以扭曲欧盟市场的国家补贴。

当时，欧委会表示，初步调查结果显示，“京东可能获得了扭曲欧盟内部市场的外国补贴”。布鲁塞尔称，调查将评估此类补贴是否使这家中国企业得以对Ceconomy开出高价，从而扭曲了收购过程的结果。调查还将审视，这笔补贴是否提升了交易完成后合并实体的竞争地位，以及是否会对欧盟内部市场的竞争产生影响。

京东方面当时做出反驳，称此次收购不会通过补贴进行融资，并否认在涉及该交易的过程中接受过任何“可能导致欧盟市场竞争扭曲”的援助。

欧委会最迟在10月2日前作出最终决定。而欧盟层面的批准，是完成股权变更的必要条件之一。

今年6月底，德国联邦经济部已批准京东收购项目，但批准附带一定条件，包括确保德国客户的个人数据得到充分保护。此外，德国政府还获得了广泛的监督和控制权，如果未来出现违规情况，政府有权撤销此次批准。

Street Signal | Online Retail Growth Holds Above 2.5% for a Third Month; JD.com Electronics Recovery Looks More Actionable Than Broad Platform Re-Rating

Online physical-goods sales rose 3.3% year over year in July, marking the third consecutive month of growth above 2.5%. Online penetration reached 25.7%, up 0.8 percentage point from a year earlier. Excluding automobiles, retail sales increased 2.5%, indicating that the consumer recovery is continuing but remains narrow and led by online channels.

Communications equipment remained strong, rising 20.4%, while the decline in home appliances narrowed sharply to 1.9% as the high-base effect from the trade-in program began to fade.

For JD.com this is a more actionable signal: the downside risk to electronics revenue is more important than the potential for a broad re-rating of the overall platform.

The note’s one-line conclusion is that online consumption is proving more resilient than offline consumption, with JD.com benefiting from easing home-appliance base pressure and strong communications-equipment sales. It identifies electronics recovery as having the highest degree of visibility.

J.P. Morgan maintains positive rating ratings on Alibaba, JD.com and Vipshop, and a neutral rating on PDD. The note says JD.com electronics-recovery thesis is not yet fully reflected in its valuation, while a broader platform re-rating will require a turning point in demand.

Key catalysts are: a continued decline in the trade-in program’s comparison base in the second half of 2026, which should further reduce the year-over-year drag from home appliances; additional policy stimulus, without which the split between weak macroeconomic conditions and strong online channels is expected to persist; JD.com second-quarter 2026

results, which should test the electronics-revenue recovery trend; and the product-launch cycle for communications equipment, including the potential lift to online sales from flagship models such as the iPhone.

7 月，线上实物商品销售同比增长 3.3%，标志着连续第三个月增长超过 2.5%。线上渗透率达到 25.7%，较一年前上升 0.8 个百分点。剔除汽车后，零售销售增长 2.5%，表明消费复苏仍在继续，但范围依然较窄，并由线上渠道引领。

通信设备仍然强劲，增长 20.4%，而家电降幅大幅收窄至 1.9%，因为以旧换新计划带来的高基数效应开始消退。

对 JD.com 来说，这是一个更具可操作性的信号：电子产品收入的下行风险，比整个平台广泛估值重估的潜力更重要。

lead_post.text:
Chinese appliance giants are cashing in on Europe’s record heat waves, with demand for air conditioners surging just as the EU debates new tariffs on Chinese imports. According to Chinese customs data, exports of air conditioners to EU countries hit $3.76 billion in the first half of 2026, up 43.2% year on year, setting a new record. Shipments to France, the Netherlands and Belgium more than doubled in the first five months, while Spain, Germany and Portugal also saw strong double-digit growth. On retail platforms the spike was even starker: at JD dot com’s European site Joybuy, AC sales jumped nearly 40 times during the June 19-25 heatwave compared with early June. Consumers are queuing and driving across borders to find stock. One Austrian buyer drove 200km to Linz to buy the last Midea PortaSplit in the country.

The boom is led by portable and easy-install models from Gree, Haier, Hisense, Midea and TCL, which fit Europe’s housing constraints better than traditional split systems. In many historic European cities, drilling into facades is banned and professional installation can cost 1,500 to 2,000 euros with waits of two months. Midea’s PortaSplit, priced around 1,000 euros and weighing under 10kg, requires no professional fitting and sold 200,000 units in Europe this year, double 2025 levels. Midea expects European consumer AC sales to grow more than 20% in Q2, Haier could see double-digit growth in the segment, and Gree reported sales in France, Italy and Spain up over 40% in the first half. Euromonitor projects Haier, Gree and Midea will together hold about 32% of the European retail AC market by volume. Chinese officials and state media are framing the surge as proof that Europe needs Chinese products, with Xinhua calling it the air conditioner paradox: Europe is too hot for tariffs on China. That argument is landing amid broader EU-China talks over a nearly 360 billion euro trade imbalance, even as commodity costs and weak domestic demand at home pressure margins for the manufacturers.

- World Business News.

lead_post.translation_zh:
中国家电巨头正从欧洲创纪录的热浪中获利，空调需求激增，而此时欧盟正就对中国进口商品征收新关税展开讨论。根据中国海关数据，2026年上半年，对欧盟国家的空调出口额达到 37.6 亿美元，同比增长 43.2%，创下新纪录。前五个月，对法国、荷兰和比利时的发货量增长了一倍多，而西班牙、德国和葡萄牙也出现了强劲的两位数增长。在零售平台上，这一激增更为明显：在 JD.com 的欧洲网站 Joybuy 上，6月19日至25日热浪期间的空调销量较6月初跃升近 40 倍。消费者正在排队并跨境驾车寻找库存。一名奥地利买家驾车 200km 前往林茨，买下了该国最后一台 Midea PortaSplit。

这轮热潮由 Gree、Haier、Hisense、Midea 和 TCL 的便携式及易安装机型引领，这些机型比传统分体式系统更适合欧洲的住房限制。在许多欧洲历史名城，禁止在外立面钻孔，而专业安装费用可达 1,500 至 2,000 欧元，等待时间长达两个月。Midea 的 PortaSplit 售价约 1,000 欧元，重量低于 10kg，无需专业安装，今年在欧洲售出 200,000 台，是 2025 年水平的两倍。Midea 预计第二季度欧洲消费者空调销量将增长超过 20%，Haier 在该细分市场可能实现两位数增长，Gree 报告称上半年在法国、意大利和西班牙的销售额增长超过 40%。Euromonitor 预计，按销量计算，Haier、Gree 和 Midea 合计将占欧洲零售空调市场约 32%。中国官员和官方媒体正将这波激增描述为欧洲需要中国产品的证据，新华社称其为空调悖论：欧洲热到无法对中国征收关税。在欧中围绕近 3600 亿欧元贸易失衡展开更广泛谈判之际，这一论点正在产生影响，尽管大宗商品成本和国内需求疲软也在挤压制造商的利润率。

- World Business News.
